comment: No family on the signal inputs or the two outputs: a switch carries whatever is given to it. The button light is written only on the branch where no select cable is patched (src/MentalABSwitches.cpp:120-136), so a switch driven from its select input leaves its button light at whatever it last showed while the A and B lights keep following the select voltage. Button states are saved with the patch.
